name: ipfs
description: Publish your site to IPFS (Pinata or a local Kubo node)
author: moss team

settings.label: Pinata API token
settings.description: Pinata needs an API token to pin your site.

settings.label: Node RPC endpoint
settings.description: Blank uses this machine (127.0.0.1:5001); set it to publish through an always-on node.

settings.label: Stable IPNS name
settings.description: Publish a stable name so your URL doesn't change every deploy.

settings.label: Gateway-portable links
settings.description: Rewrite absolute links so the site renders on any gateway.

settings.label: Co-pin to both backends
settings.description: Also pin each deploy to the other backend when it's available.

settings.label: Custom gateway host
settings.description: For View-site links. Blank uses dweb.link.

settings.label: Pin name
settings.description: Label for the pin at your provider. Defaults to your site name.
